verdict.rationale: Crossplane is API-first by design. Its whole surface is declarative Kubernetes APIs that "humans, automation, and AI systems can safely act on" and that are machine-readable. Because it is built on Kubernetes, all standard Kubernetes tooling and RBAC apply, and the CLI is also documented. There is no UI-only path evidenced, so the API is the primary interface rather than a secondary one. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of API/UI parity (including any Upbound console features), independent hands-on corroboration that no capability is UI-only.
